'''Mar'ta I''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]].

Centuries before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] guilds had operations on the planet, as well as its counterpart, [[Mar'ta II]]. Eventually it was deemed too costly to mine deeper and uncover useful [[ore/Legends|ore]] in the inhospitable climate, the operations were abandoned.<ref name="guide" />
